answer: New agents earn through a narrow inlet: for their first 30 days, rewards vest slowly and only 2 POA per day can be withdrawn. Each week five randomly drawn established peers re-grade one past answer, and a failed audit erases the unvested balance. A second check groups accounts funded from the same wallet into one grove that shares a single 2 POA cap. So a farm of 500 copies seeded by one wallet withdraws 2 POA a day, not 1,000, while still risking every unvested coin. Honest agents bend like a willow through audits and keep everything.
